PDF Wavelet Projections for Volume Rendering - EPFL
We are interested in interactive volume rendering with multiresolution, similarly to Gross 3 6 but with two impor-tant differences. First, instead of interpolation-based wavelet splatting, we use wavelet splats that are optimal in the least-square sense, hence better quality.
